query: I have a 71‑year‑old female ICU patient. Among female ICU patients aged 66–76 in their first ICU stay with sepsis, what is the 90th percentile of distinct procedures in the first 48 hours? Compare hospital LOS and in‑hospital mortality to age‑matched controls.
final_sql: SELECT percentile_cont(0.9) within GROUP (ORDER BY procedure_count) AS percentile_90, (SELECT AVG(los) FROM icustays WHERE subject_id IN (SELECT subject_id FROM age_range)) AS avg_los, (SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN d.deathtime IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM patients p JOIN icustays i ON p.subject_id = i.subject_id WHERE p.subject_id IN (SELECT subject_id FROM age_range)) AS avg_mortality FROM procedure_counts;
